summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Seabridge Gold Inc. reporting that the Supreme Court of British Columbia issued a decision on petitions challenging the BC Environmental Assessment Office's determination that Seabridge's KSM project was 'substantially started.' The Court upheld the reasonableness of the determination but required further consultation with the Tsetsaut Skii km Lax Ha. There are no merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, or other special-situation elements. This is a routine legal update regarding an environmental assessment process. No deal terms are present.
